engine: sympy exact QQ(q); mpmath mpf for the single q0 evaluation

results.verdict: The Frobenius pairing restricted to Z(H_3(q)) is DIAGONAL in the central-idempotent basis, with nonzero diagonal. So two DISTINCT curvature-rank strata -- each a span of idempotents -- pair to IDENTICALLY ZERO, and each stratum is SELF-dual. The asserted 'rank-l pairs with rank-(N-l)' is zero exactly where it claims to be perfect, whenever l != N-l. This is the qou-xsv8 defect, present in prf:spectral-sequence-collapse as well as in prf:quantum-dilogarithm-stratified Step 1.
results.scope: (b) structural exclusion -- the invariant is e_l.e_m = 0 for l != m, which holds for every linear functional and every n, so no choice of filtration or of Frobenius form can restore a cross-stratum pairing on idempotent strata.

assertions.name: A1_offdiagonal_identically_zero

assertions.name: A3_completeness_selftest

assertions.name: A4_diagonal_is_Te_coefficient
assertions.detail: B(e_lambda, e_lambda) = tau(e_lambda) = the T_e coefficient, as it must be for an idempotent
